releases.name: 3.0.0: one entry point, one reference
releases.notes:
## Install

Minimal package: `opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.0-min.zip` contains only what the skill runs — `SKILL.md`, `references/` (one doc plus two dated seeds), `scripts/` (one entry point + modules) and `LICENSE`. Unzip it into `~/.config/opencode/skills/` so the folder is named `opencode-go-model-picker`. Verify with `node scripts/go.mjs --help` (four verbs: `run` / `report` / `check` / `apply`).

Full notes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · 中文：[CHANGELOG-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md)

## [3.0.0] - 2026-11-01

### The size of the simplification

3.0.0 is not a feature release: it is the same job described with **an order of
magnitude less text**. Measured against the 2.0.0 tag:

| What the model must read | 2.0.0 | 3.0.0 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Markdown files | 7 (`SKILL.md` + 6 references) | 2 (`SKILL.md` + `plan-facts.md`) | −5 files |
| Characters | 104,181 | 8,291 | **12.6× smaller** (−92%) |
| Lines | 1,776 | 168 | **10.6× fewer** (−91%) |
| Estimated tokens | ≈27,400 | ≈2,200 | **≈25,200 saved per full read** |
| `SKILL.md` alone | 18,804 chars ≈4,900 tok | 4,221 chars ≈1,100 tok | −78% |
| Runnable entry points | 9 runtime scripts (11 with maintainer tools) | 1 (`go.mjs`) | −8 runtime |
| Minimal install zip | 128,802 B | 89,163 B | −3…

releases.name: v1.2.0
releases.notes:
# v1.2.0

`skill_management` gives every installed OpenCode skill a switch: list what is installed, find out
why one will not load, hide it from the model, and put it back. Disabling writes **one** global
`skill` permission rule — no skill file is ever moved, edited or deleted.

**No breaking changes in 1.2.0.** The four actions, their inputs, the JSON envelope, the written
rule shape, the same-line marker and the single-file layout are unchanged since 1.1.0.

## Fixed since v1.1.0

- **`list` no longer reports "N skills differ across other agents" on every call.**
 `summary.diverged` counted hidden internal agents (`title`, `summary`, …), which carry
 `{*,*,deny}`; on a real machine that made every skill look divergent (33/33) and added a noise
 warning to each `list`. Only **visible** agents are compared now; `inspect.agents[]` still lists
 every agent, so the detail is not lost.
- **Frontmatter booleans no longer contradict each other.** `disable-model-invocation: "false"` is a
 string, and `Boolean("false") === true`, so `inspect` reported it as `true` while `list` reported
 `autoinvoke: false` for the same file. `true/yes/on/1` and `false/no/off/0` (quoted or not) are
 normalized now, and both fields go through the same rule.
- **A failed sidecar write no longer turns a successful config change into an error.** Once the
 config was written and verified, a sidecar write fa…

en.headline: 27 own commits plus 16 automated commits across five repositories
en.summary: **27 own commits** landed across five repositories, plus 16 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, work covered releases `v1.2.0` and `1.2.1`, serialized write enable/disable to avoid concurrent overwrites, and a targeted hard rejection for unparsable target config files. Documentation there added Chinese release notes, moved npm to the recommended install channel, added design-decisions and development pages, and expanded Effects to deny vs ask. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`, the entry point was consolidated into four verbs with one reference, test artifacts were removed, and release measurements were corrected. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` gained minimal verification steps for `knowledge-ingest` and documented the division of three review commands. `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` corrected the G2 status, documented the Google 2 key path, and added settings guidance for obtaining that key. `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` received a daily-report workflow change to validate generated artifacts as a gate. No pull requests, issues, reviews, or discussions were recorded.

releaseNotes.summary: The release consolidates the skill into a single entry point with four verbs (`run`, `report`, `check`, `apply`) and one reference document. The minimal package contains only `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `scripts/`, and `LICENSE`, and can be verified with `node scripts/go.mjs --help`.

This release keeps the four actions, JSON envelope, written rule shape, and single-file layout unchanged from 1.1.0, with no breaking changes. It fixes `list` so hidden internal agents no longer make every skill appear divergent, and disabling a skill writes one global `skill` permission rule without moving, editing, or deleting skill files.

zh.headline: 27 次本人提交，另有 16 次自动提交，覆盖五个仓库
zh.summary: 当天在五个仓库完成 **27 次本人提交**，另有 16 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`，工作涵盖 `v1.2.0` 与 `1.2.1` 发布、串行化写入的启用与停用以避免并发覆盖，以及仅对目标配置文件硬拒绝无法解析的情况。文档方面补充了中文发布说明，将 npm 提升为推荐安装通道，新增 design-decisions 与 development 页面，并把 Effects 扩展为 deny 与 ask 两种模式。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`，入口被整合为四个动词和一份参考文档，移除了测试产物，并修正了发布说明中的测量数据。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 为 `knowledge-ingest` 补充了最小验证步骤，并说明三种审查命令的分工。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 修正了 G2 状态，记录了 Google 2 密钥路径，并在设置卡片中补充获取该密钥的指引。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的日报工作流增加了对生成物的校验门禁。当天没有记录拉取请求、issue、评审或讨论。

releaseNotes.summary: 该版本将技能整合为单一入口，包含四个动词（`run`、`report`、`check`、`apply`）和一份参考文档。最小包仅含 `SKILL.md`、`references/`、`scripts/` 与 `LICENSE`，可通过 `node scripts/go.mjs --help` 验证。
该版本相对 1.1.0 保持四个动作、JSON 信封、写入规则格式和单文件布局不变，无破坏性变更。它修复了 `list` 把隐藏内部代理误判为技能分歧的问题，停用技能时只写入一条全局 `skill` 权限规则，不移动、编辑或删除技能文件。
